svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: AIcoach – epics and stories with dependencies
svg.text: AIcoach — 8 epics, 63 stories, and what must be done first

Arrow A → B: A must be done before B can be finished. Columns are the earliest step a story can start (longest chain of dependencies before it); stories in the same column can be done in parallel. Redundant arrows (implied by a longer chain) are left out.
Source: epics.md (2026-11-26). P1 due 2026-12-01 · P2 (chat) due 2026-12-08 · P3 stretch · hand-in 2026-12-15.
